scope: Pure retained-stroke kernel only. No UI/render/storage/history/private-link implementation edits or runtime.

independence.expectedResults: Literal paths/paint indices/coordinate arrays/complete graph substitutions and scalar boundaries authored from the approved contract. No production localPoint, edit transformation, hit helper or renderer calculates expected values.
independence.image: Original hand-assembled one-pixel PNG with literal RGBA[23,45,67,255], own CRC/chunk construction and zlib encoding. Size-bound fixture uses inert original tEXt padding.
independence.honestFirstRun: First actual run was already against actual implementation and passed. No independent oracle before-implementation RED is claimed. Producer-owned stub RED is separate.
independence.afterFreezeChange: Only removed unused type-only Point import after scoped lint/type diagnostics. No fixture, numeric tolerance or expected acceptance changed.

frozenExpectations.roundCap: Width10 segment(0,0)..(10,0):(-3,4)/(13,4)/(5,5) inclusive; y plus1e-8 refuses. Padding6 admits(5,11), y plus1e-8 refuses.
frozenExpectations.graph: Two exact cels at0/8, independent second drawing and original PNG layer. Title/background/poses/keys/image/stroke case/negative-zero/unselected arrays remain exactly equal.
frozenExpectations.delete: Only selected path removed; first cel may become blank while its frame0 boundary and all other graph values remain.
frozenExpectations.coordinateLimit: (1279,1279),(0,-1280) plus(1,0) becomes(1280,1279),(1,-1280); +1e-8 overflow or nonfinite delta refuses whole candidate without input changes.

serializedLimit.expected: Zero-delta admits full detached graph; valid-coordinate nonzero edit exceeds canonical cap and refuses atomically.

verification.status: one unused type-only Point import diagnostic; corrected without acceptance changes

checks: Exact plain target/point/appearance admission rejects unsupported/accessor/nonfinite data without mutating input.
Retained strokes use shared bounded model admission; hit search is reversed paint order with inclusive closed-segment/dot geometry.
Nonzero segment nearest-point projection is clamped; repeated segments and one-point paths are explicit round targets.
Exact layer and cel boundary plus integer index are required, with no implicit held-cel fallback.
All edits start with detached complete model validation and finish with full candidate validation, covering coordinate/count/canonical byte bounds.
Zero displacement preserves coordinate negative-zero spelling; no incremental/resampled path derivation or unselected graph normalization.
Appearance updates only selected color/width; Delete splices only selected stroke and preserves empty cel boundaries.

limitations: No full suite/build/browser/service/Git actions; root owns broad/native/media/durability acceptance.
CSS padding conversion, transformed native pointer handling, caret/lifetime/history and PNG/GIF output are outside this pure kernel oracle.
Original padded PNGs exercise pure retained-project byte admission; no native PNG decode outcome is claimed here.
